description: CRIC Data provides AI-powered access to nearly 20 years of CRIC-licensed China real estate data. Wenshu supports natural-language queries, rankings, trends, and city comparisons across nine domains, while Wenzhi answers professional questions about real estate, property management, and senior care.

display.description_en: CRIC Data provides AI-powered access to nearly 20 years of CRIC-licensed China real estate data. Wenshu supports natural-language queries, rankings, trends, and city comparisons across nine domains, while Wenzhi answers professional questions about real estate, property management, and senior care.
display.description_zh: 克而瑞地产数据依托经克而瑞授权、积累近 20 年的中国不动产数据。「问数」覆盖新房、二手房、土地、企业、宏观、长租公寓、产城、康养、商办九大领域，支持自然语言查询、排行、趋势与多城对比；「问知」提供地产、物业、银发领域的政策、研究、企业、法规和运营知识问答。
examples_en: Show new home transactions in Shanghai for the last month
Compare resale listing prices across Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen
Top 10 land deals by value in Hangzhou this year
Interpret the latest real estate regulation policy direction
What are the standard practices for property management complaint handling
